sub_site: ovarian cancer and endometrial cancer tumour tissue (cervical cancer arm excluded as mucosal)

data_source.dataset: Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University

evidence.quote: A total of 90 patients, hospitalized in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University
The rDNA of bacterial ribosome subunit 16S (V1-V9 region) was amplified using universal primer 27F and 1492R
singletons OTUs, namely OTUs with an abundance of 1 in all samples, and their representative sequences were removed from the OTU table

notes: 90 tumours (30 cervix, 30 ovary, 30 endometrium); only ovary + endometrium (n=60) are target sites, but shared-taxa statistics pooled all 90. Genera recorded where ovary/endometrium mean abundance reported >0. Prevotella (cervix only) not recorded. Top-10 genus profile only in Fig 2C. No negative controls; only surface disinfection and sterile instruments mentioned.
